items.explanation: A habit on foot: chodzić. Codziennie is the signal word.
optionNotes: Idę is for one trip now or planned.
Jadę is by vehicle, one trip.
Jeżdżę is by vehicle; pieszo means on foot.

items.prompt: Teraz ___ do sklepu, zaraz wracam. (on foot)
items.explanation: One trip in one direction, right now: iść.
optionNotes: Chodzę is for habits, not for one trip now.
Jeżdżę is by vehicle and for habits.
Latam is for flying, as a habit.

items.explanation: A repeated trip by car: jeździć. W soboty (on Saturdays) shows a habit.
optionNotes: Jadę is for one trip, not for every Saturday.

items.prompt: W zeszłym roku ___ do Hiszpanii. (we, by plane)
items.explanation: One finished trip by plane in the past: the perfective polecieć.
optionNotes: Latamy is present and means a habit.
